notes.title: New Horror Anomalies
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has supported us by purchasing and playing [i]Floor 0[/i].
We have enjoyed watching the content some of you have created, and we have listened to what you have enjoyed and disliked about the game.

Therefore, we decided to add 3 new anomalies with a focus on horror to the game, increasing the total number of anomalies to [b]35![/b] We have also added 3 new achievements to go with these.

Each floor chooses whether or not an anomaly will be present (with the exception of floor 10), then randomly chooses 1 of the 35 anomalies for the floors that were chosen to have an anomaly. Therefore, no 2 playthroughs will be the same. Hunting for these new anomalies may not be as easy as you'd hope, but they are worth it.

In addition, a head bob toggle has been added to the 'gameplay' settings to allow players to experience [i]Floor 0[/i] without camera shake while walking.

Again, we would like to thank you all for all of your support.
